label: Another Katrina-scale disaster
description: A US disaster on the scale of Hurricane Katrina, tied by him to touching the Holy Land; word dated 10 July 2026.

label: The southern border floods again in 2028
description: If Democrats win the midterms and 2028, the southern border is flooded again; the midterms are framed as the thing that decides it.

label: Kamala Harris rebrands and runs again in 2028
description: Harris prepares another presidential run for 2028 and rebrands herself, which he says the Lord had already stated.

label: Plots against churches and against the elections
description: He sees plots aimed at American churches and at the elections, alongside Korean escalation.

label: The Antichrist arrives as the Mahdi and is MBS
description: From his 2014 tribulation vision: the Antichrist will be a Muslim called the Mahdi, and the man he saw looked like Mohammed bin Salman.

label: Watch Judas: a betrayal from Trump's own circle
description: The Lord said to watch Judas, pointing to betrayal of Trump from close to him, after God protected him from assassination.

label: The 2026 midterms matter more than 2024
description: The Lord said the midterms are more important than the 2024 election because of the governors and mayors, and the direction of everything is known by the first week of November.

label: The shmita cycle ending 2029 carries the great awakening
description: The next shmita cycle ends in 2029, and the great awakening and revival are prayed into that window.

label: A special forces raid on Iranian nuclear material
description: Seen in February: a fence, men off a stealth helicopter, three major places; matched later to reports of US special forces on standby for an Iran nuclear material operation.

label: Iran holds an untested bomb meant for Israel
description: Iran has an unperfected, untested device kept in a mountain that they do not want to waste and intend to use on Israel.
aliases: they believe they have a bomb

label: A request for more military aid next week
description: He sees a leader asking for more money and military aid in the week after 26 July 2026.

label: An earth-facing event arriving by 28 July
description: Something earth-facing was forecast to reach earth by 28 July 2026, warned about on the 17th.

label: Cloned soulless humans farmed for organs and animal hybrids
description: From a 7 July 2025 vision: labs in America, Japan and Asia clone people treated as soulless, harvest their organs, and cross them with animal DNA to make demon-possessed super people.

label: A 24 September AI race meeting in America
description: A meeting in America on 24 September 2026 focused on the AI race, which he says he saw was a major race.

label: He doubts a red wave and invites being judged on it
description: Against viewers expecting a total red wave he says he prays he is completely off and tells them to stop watching him if a wave bigger than 2024 arrives.

label: More than half of England in official drought
description: Over half of England formally declared in drought, with no water and heavy drone activity noted alongside.
